paite: Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi.
heading: Mimalmal Mohpuakna

paite: "Israel gam tungtang a hiai paunak azat uh bang chihna ahia, 'Pate'n grep thuk ane ua, atate uh ha azau hi, chih?'
"Kei ka hin bang in, Israel ah hiai paunak zat nawn chih na nei kei ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Ngai un, hinna tengteng kei a vek ahi, pa hinna kei a ahih bangmah in tapa hinna leng kei a ahi; kha khial peuhmah asi ding.
"Himahleh mi adiktat a, siang leh dik ahih a,
mun sangte a ne lou a, Israel inkote milim lam nga sam lou a, numei kizen lou leng naih lou a, kuamah tung a thil hihkhial lou a,
leibami thil khamna koih pe kik zaw a, kuamah hiamgam a lok lou a, gilkial kiang a nek ding pia a, vuaktang puan silhsak a;
apung delh ding a leitawisak lou a, asumpung leng la sam lou a, thil gilou hih dia akhut kidek a, mi leh mi kikal a diktak a vai hawmsak a;
ka dan bawlte zui a, diktak a hih a, ka vaihawmnate azuihleh, amah midiktat ahi a, ahing ngei ding chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
"Himahleh ama'n tapa guktak ching asuan a, sisan suahmi ahih a, hiai bang ahih a,
ahih ding zaw pen ahih louh a, mun sangte a anek zawk a, invengte zi ahihbuah a,
genthei leh tasamte asimmoh a, aloh a, akhamna koih apiak louh a, milimte lam nga, thilkihhuai ahih hi.
Apung delh a apiak a, apung alakleh, ahing ding hia? Ahing het kei ding; hiai thilkihhuai tengteng ahihta a, asi ngeingei ding, amah sisan moh ama tung ah atu ding ahi.
"Huan ngai in, tapa na nei tei taleh, apa thil gilou hihsa tengteng amuh a, lau a,
huchibang ahih teitei louh a, mun sang a anek louh a, Israel inkote milim lamte angat louh a, invengte zi ahihnit louh a,
kuamah tung a thil ahihkhelh louh a, khamna koih bangmah la lou a, kuamah lok lou a, gilkialte nek ding pe zaw a, savuakte asilhsak a;
genthei lak a akhut akideksak a, anou leh apung la lou a, ka thupiakte zang a ka dan bawlte zuimi ahihleh, apa thulimlouhna ziak in asi kei ding a, ahing zaw ngei ding hi.
Apa bel kheltak a mi nuaisiah a, a-unaupa hiamgamtak a sual a, amite lak a thil hoih lou ahih ziak in, ngai in, athulimlouhna ziak in asi ding ahi.
"Himahleh, bangziak a tapa in apa thulimlouhna thuak lou ding, na chi nak uh? Tapa in dan azuih a thil kizen ahih a, ka dan bawl tengteng azuih a, ahih laileh, ahing ngeingei ding hi.

Kha khial asi ding; tapa in apa thulimlouhna athuak kei ding a, pa in leng tapa thulimlouhna athuak sam kei ding; midiktat diktatna amah mah tung ah a-om ding, migilou gitlouhna amah mah tung ah a-om ding hi.
"Himahleh, migilou in akhelhna hih tengteng alehngatsan a, ka dan bawlte azuih a, dan zui a thil diktat ahihleh ahing ngei ding a, asi kei ding.
Tatlekna a na hihsa theihsak ahita kei ding; ana hihsa adiktatna ah ahing ding,
Migilou sihna ah kipahna ka nei a hia? Alampite alehngatsan a, ahong hin ding chih louh ngal? chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.

"Himahleh midiktat in adiktatna lampi alehngatsan a, thulimlouhna ahih a, migiloute hih bang zel a thilkihhuaite ahih in ahing dia hia? Athil diktat hihsa bangpeuh leng theihgige ahi nawnta kei ding a, atatlekna hih ah leh akhelhna hih ah, huai mahmah ah asi ding hi.
"Hinapi in, TOUPA hihdan akibang gige kei hi, na chi sek uh. Israel inkote aw, ngai un; ka hihdan akibang gige kei maw? Na hihdan uh akibang kei gige zaw ahi kei maw?
Midiktat in adiktatnate alehngatsan a, thulimlouhnate ahihleh huai ah asi ding a, thulimlouhna ahih ah asi ding.
Huai lou leng, migilou in akhelhna ahihsate lehngatsan a, dan azuih a, thil diktat ahihleh ahinna ahumbit ding.
Akingaihtuah a, atatlekna a hihsa tengteng alehngatsan ziak in ahing ngei ding, asi kei ding hi.
Hinapi in Israel inkote'n, TOUPA hihdan akibang gige kei, achi uhi. Aw Israel inkote aw, ka hihdante kibang gige ahi zaw kei maw?

"Huaiziak in aw Israel inkote aw, michih, noumau hihdan bang zel in vai ka hon hawmsak ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi. Kihei unla, na tatlekna tengtengte uh lehngatsan un; huchi in thulimlouhna na puksiatna uh ahi kei ding hi.
Na tatlekna tengteng uh, na tatleksate uh paimang vek unla, lungtang thak leh lungsim thak kibawl un! Israel inkote aw, bangziak a si ding na hi ua?
Mi sihna ah kipahna mahmah ka nei kei, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi; huaiziak in kihei unla, hing un."
